method: Both readers run with the same --media-dir; plans compared as normalized JSON (all keys, values and order of tracks/clips/sources/warnings).

identical_plans.case: frame-based master/source slots with nested offsets
source window start moved inside master

both_refuse: two composition mobs without explicit choice
known_differences: Error texts name classes (e.g. 'TimelineMobSlot 1') instead of Python object reprs.
WAV headers are parsed by a bounded RIFF chunk reader; WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE with PCM subtype is accepted (Python 3.10 wave rejects it).
